records.speaker: System
records.clean_Japanese:
拿捕した船から
金%sを得ました
records.english: You recovered %s gold from captured ships.
records.context: The original victory branch combines capture proceeds and passes the native formatted amount before crediting the player.
records.source_meaning: The game reports the amount of money obtained from captured vessels.
records.localization_note: Keep the recovered gold distinct from the later national award. 'Captured ships' identifies the source without specifying a count. Keep “from captured ships” together on the second line.

records.speaker: System
records.clean_Japanese:
国家からの報償金として
金%sを得ました
records.context: The original victory accounting selects this separate reward after computing the amount. It is distinct from the money recovered from ships.
records.source_meaning: The player received the named monetary amount as a national reward.
records.localization_note: Keep the nation as the source of this separate award and use the same gold term as the capture notice. Keep the amount with “gold” whenever the notice needs two lines.
